prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: ONE production frame 03 of a continuous ten-frame photographic camera journey inside a freshwater aquascape. Output ONE image, landscape 2:1, consistent 2048x1024 composition, not a contact sheet.
Input image roles: reference image 1 is the ORIGINAL MASTER/frame01; it anchors the exact identity, topology, material, color, lighting and water clarity of this aquarium. Reference image 2 is the IMMEDIATELY PREVIOUS frame 02; it anchors continuity and the preceding physical camera viewpoint. The original master remains the authority on scene identity.
Primary request: photograph the SAME aquarium from the NEXT slightly more forward camera position. Reconstruct a small real change of viewpoint with depth-dependent parallax and newly revealed surfaces behind nearby leaves, rocks and driftwood. This is a physical forward dolly, NOT a digital crop/zoom or a duplicate with changed scale, NOT zooming out, and NOT a newly arranged aquascape.
Camera production direction: fixed natural 55mm lens and fixed focal length; total forward distance 6 cm beyond frame01; height 22.8 cm above ground; total rightward drift 1.3 cm; total rightward pan 1.6 degrees. The step from the previous frame is only 3 cm forward and about 1.1 cm lower. These are artistic camera directions, not a measured scene reconstruction. Keep adjacent framing differences subtle enough for a cinematic dissolve.
Invariant world: the recognizable weathered dark driftwood branch originates at left and reaches toward upper center; foreground slate-gray rocks remain anchored at lower left; the same broad green fern leaves and fine feathery green plants surround the wood; the same reddish stems remain on the left. A pale fine-sand winding path leads from the foreground toward the back at center-right. Cyan clear open water remains upper/right, with the water surface/ripples and natural daylight from upper left. Preserve exact relative arrangement, plant types, texture, rock shapes, wood silhouette, sand color, exposure and realism. Near objects shift more than far objects as the camera advances. Reveal only plausible previously occluded detail, without adding decorative objects.
Rendering: a real high-quality underwater photograph, crisp natural textures, restrained water haze in distance, consistent daylight and white balance. No digital painting, no toy geometry, no stylized 3D render, no artificial glow.
Exclude completely: fish or any animals (separate sprites will be overlaid), people, room, exterior glass frame, tank rim, UI, text, labels, logos, watermarks, filters or equipment, coral, ocean imagery. Do not redesign or simplify the aquarium. Fill the entire 2:1 frame with the underwater view; no borders. Generate just this one next camera frame.
